channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Unnao rape: Delhi HC Rejects Kuldeep Sengar’s Plea to Suspend 10-year Sentence in Custodial Death
item.description: The Delhi High Court refused to suspend Kuldeep Sengar’s sentence, citing the gravity of custodial death and survivor safety concerns.

item.title: Jammu Horror: 45-Year-Old Woman Found Alive, Bound Inside Plastic Bag in Rajouri; Police Launch Probe
item.description: A 45-year-old woman was rescued alive after being found tied inside a plastic bag in Jammu and Kashmir’s Rajouri district, prompting a police investigation.

item.title: Bengaluru Matrimonial Scam: Woman Alleges ₹1.5 Crore Fraud as Man Introduced Wife as ‘Sister’
item.description: A Bengaluru software engineer alleges she was emotionally manipulated and financially cheated of over ₹1.5 crore by a man who promised marriage while hiding his existing family.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: One Dead, Several Injured in Helium Gas Cylinder Explosion at Thenpennai River Festival
item.description: One dead and 18 injured after a helium cylinder used for filling balloons exploded during the Thenpennai River Festival.

item.title: Bank Employees’ Unions Call Strike on Jan 27, Demand Five-Day Work Week
item.description: A proposed nationwide bank strike on January 27, combined with existing holidays, could disrupt physical banking services across India for four consecutive days.

item.title: Kozhikode Resident Donates 4 Cents of Land Under LIFE Mission, Giving Homeless Family Safety, Dignity, and Hope
item.description: A small act of generosity under Kerala’s LIFE Mission is helping a struggling Narakkode family rebuild their life.

item.title: Karnataka Suspends Senior DGP After Alleged Office Misconduct Goes Viral
item.description: The Karnataka government suspended a senior IPS officer after alleged intimate videos from his office sparked outrage and calls for accountability.

item.title: RBI Proposes Linking BRICS Digital Currencies to Boost Cross-Border Payments, Cut Dollar Dependence
item.description: RBI proposes linking BRICS digital currencies to ease trade and tourism payments, aiming for formal inclusion in the 2026 summit agenda.

item.title: From Walking Miles in Kolkata to Reshaping Medicine: Deblina Sarkar’s Microscopic Chips That Target the Brain Without Surgery
item.description: MIT scientist Deblina Sarkar invents injectable microscopic chips capable of precise brain-targeted therapy without surgery.

item.title: ‘Will Kill You’: Gurugram Doctor Arrested for Allegedly Running Scorpio Over Swiggy Delivery Agent
item.description: Gurugram police arrest an Ayurvedic doctor for repeatedly running his SUV over a delivery rider after a parking row.
